items.exampleEn: I missed the bus, so consequently I was late for work.
items.exampleZh: 我搭不到公車，所以遲到了。

items.exampleEn: Goodness, I can't find my phone anywhere!
items.exampleZh: 天哪，我到處都找不到手機！

items.exampleEn: We finished dinner and went for a walk afterwards.
items.exampleZh: 我們吃完晚餐，後來去散步。

items.exampleEn: The cat was hiding underneath the table.
Let's go someplace quiet to relax.
items.exampleZh: 我們去個安靜的地方放鬆一下。

items.exampleEn: Gee, I didn't know you could draw so well!
items.exampleZh: 哎呀，我居然不知道你畫得這麼好！

items.exampleEn: You should enjoy yourself, not always think of others.
items.exampleZh: 你應該享受自己，不要總是想到別人。

items.exampleEn: You can sit in whichever chair you like.
items.exampleZh: 你可以坐任何一把椅子。

items.sentenceEn: Consequently, I had to wait at the bus stop for twenty minutes.
items.sentenceZh: 因此，我不得不在公車站等二十分鐘。

items.audioEn: Afterwards, we went underneath the bridge to take some photos.
items.audioZh: 後來，我們走到橋下面去拍一些照片。

items.sentenceEn: Afterwards, she went someplace quiet to read a book.
items.sentenceZh: 後來，她去了某個安靜的地方看書。

items.sentenceEn: Whichever path you choose, enjoy yourself on the way.
items.sentenceZh: 不管你選哪條路，享受過程吧。

items.stemEn: I looked under the bed and found the keys ____ the bed frame.
items.stemZh: 我往床底下看，發現鑰匙在床架下面。

items.stemEn: I'm tired. Let's go ____ quiet to rest.
items.stemZh: 我累了。我們去個安靜的地方休息吧。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I went someplace quiet in the mountains. I was very tired, so consequently I decided to rest by a lake. Underneath a big tree, I found a bench and sat down. Afterwards, I walked along the path. Whichever direction I looked, I saw beautiful flowers. Gee, the view was amazing! I had a great time by myself. I enjoyed myself so much that I forgot about time.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我去了山上某個安靜的地方。我很累，所以就在湖邊休息。我在一棵大樹下面找到一張長椅，坐了下來。後來，我沿著小徑散步。不管往哪個方向看，都能看到漂亮的花。哎呀，景色真美！我獨自玩得很開心，完全忘了時間。

items.promptZh: 他生病了，所以( consequently )他沒有來上班。
referenceEn: He was sick, so consequently he didn't come to work.
He was ill, consequently he stayed home from work.
rubricZh: 正確使用 consequently 表達因果關係
意思完整，包含生病和未到上班兩個資訊

items.instructionZh: 寫一個句子，描述你做完一件事之後又做了另一件事，使用 afterwards 表示「後來」。
referenceEn: I finished my homework and went for a walk afterwards.
We had dinner and watched a movie afterwards.
I took a shower and went to bed afterwards.
rubricZh: 正確使用 afterwards 表示時間上的「後來」
